question: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS), launched in _______ by the Ministry of Finance, offers an alternative to the New Pension System for central government employees.
solution:
The correct answer is __**August 2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The **Unified Pension Scheme (UPS)** was launched by the **Ministry of Finance** in **August 2024** as an alternative to the **New Pension System (NPS)** for central government employees.

• It aims to provide government employees with a **comprehensive pension framework**, ensuring financial stability post-retirement.

• The scheme was introduced as a response to **demands for a simplified and unified pension system** for central government personnel.

• The **New Pension System (NPS)**, introduced earlier, required employees to contribute to their pension, whereas the UPS offers additional benefits to address concerns raised by employees.
